data.description: This spell functions like charm person, except that mass charm person affects a number of humanoid creatures whose combined Hit Dice don't exceed %1. If there are more potential targets than you can affect, you choose them one at a time until you reach the limit of HD you can affect. If you cast mass charm person on only one creature, you ignore the spell's HD limit.|CASTERLEVEL*2|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell

raw_tokens.value: As charm person, but affects multiple creatures within 30 ft.|!PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell

This spell functions like charm person, except that mass charm person affects a number of humanoid creatures whose combined Hit Dice don't exceed %1. If there are more potential targets than you can affect, you choose them one at a time until you reach the limit of HD you can affect. If you cast mass charm person on only one creature, you ignore the spell's HD limit.|CASTERLEVEL*2|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
One or more humanoid creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
